name: mgo
description: Self-hosted web player for Java ME, Symbian and N-Gage games

scripts.build: npm run build -w @mgo/protocol && npm run build -w @mgo/api && npm run build -w @mgo/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @mgo/protocol && npm run typecheck -w @mgo/protocol -w @mgo/api -w @mgo/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @mgo/api && npm run test -w @mgo/web
scripts.test:e2e: node tests/e2e/browser.mjs && node tests/e2e/player-ux.mjs && node tests/e2e/round3.mjs && node tests/e2e/player-features.mjs && node tests/e2e/text-input.mjs && node tests/e2e/pause.mjs && node tests/e2e/soundfont.mjs && node tests/e2e/player-tools.mjs && node tests/e2e/emulation-options.mjs && node --import tsx tests/e2e/orientation.mjs && node --import tsx tests/e2e/setup.mjs && node tests/e2e/recovery.mjs && node --import tsx tests/e2e/ui-feedback.mjs && node --import tsx tests/e2e/genres.mjs && node --import tsx tests/e2e/library-tools.mjs && node --import tsx tests/e2e/ui-polish.mjs && node tests/e2e/phone-expansion.mjs && node tests/e2e/symbian.mjs && node --import tsx tests/e2e/library-platforms.mjs && node tests/e2e/phones-native.mjs && node tests/e2e/production-readiness.mjs
scripts.build:dev: VITE_DEVELOPER_BUILD=true npm run build && npm run build:dev -w @mgo/api
scripts.fixtures:dev: bash tests/fixtures/testmidlet/build.sh runtime/build/kemulator/KEmulator.jar && bash tests/fixtures/labgames/build.sh runtime/build/kemulator/KEmulator.jar
